segments.text: Your knee is moving better than last time, Mr Shah.
Do the sit to stand exercise, ten repetitions, twice a day.
Um, keep doing them for six weeks and use the chair for balance.
If the pain gets worse at night or the knee swells, stop and call the clinic.
Come back and see me in two weeks.
